anchor_policy: All reported bboxes are same-kind references from the exact authority listed. Do not infer layout or touch bounds from raster pixels. When exact bounds are not specified by an approved source, measure runtime bounds and compare the source-defined relationship instead of inventing coordinates.

anchors.layout_bounds: Scene canvas uses the Empty Home responsive_mapping_contract uniform cover transform.
anchors.touch_bounds: none; decorative background excluded from accessibility/focus.
anchors.tolerance: source SHA exact; no screenshot crop or non-uniform scale

anchors.tolerance: CTA visible ink uses registered source mask plus geometry/glyph tolerance; touch has no tolerance

anchors.visual_bounds: Near-white core inclusive bbox (450,1590)–(628,1773); warm-gold mask bbox (439,1593)–(638,1789).

anchors.touch_bounds: >=48x48dp and safe-window-contained; exact runtime semantics rectangle must be recorded.
anchors.tolerance: compare like-kind mask only after one Normal Home responsive transform

anchors.visual_bounds: Full app window; Morning Lake master is the only Normal Home background source.
anchors.layout_bounds: Centered ContentScale.Crop on the viewport; no source rewrite, extra tint/adjustment, global blur, or UI baked into image.
